title: Dannyse D.:
title_short: Dannyse D. · The last five seconds
headline: She did not know much about basketball. In the last five seconds of a game the adrenaline hit, and now she tells everyone to play.
story: Dannyse calls herself a slow writer: smart, but she likes to take her time. Math Hoops makes her go quick, and that is what she likes.
She learned basketball through the game, made friends through good sportsmanship, and closes with the best ask in the set: everyone should play.
Loops: L1 “Did they get it?” opens at 0:00 and closes at 0:11 (“it was like a good reward”). L2 “Why does speed matter to her?” opens at 0:17 and closes at 0:27. Stakes: a slow writer in a fast game.
do: Open on “it was like the last five seconds” with the hook text already on screen.
Cut to hands on the board on “spinning the dice”.
Put <q>you have to go quick</q> on screen as she says it.
End on “It's gonna make a good difference in your life”, then the Donate end card.
Captions spell her name Dannyse if it ever appears (the transcript writes Denise).
dont: Do not use her intro: she says her full name and her school.
Do not use the school name the student says at the start.
No logo, name or fade at 0:00.
No end-of-year campaign words on the end card.
